# Retirement manifest — legacy canvas page-host removal (2026-07).
#
# One retired symbol/string per line. An `allow <substring>  # why` line
# following a symbol whitelists a specific survivor that is deliberately
# staying (grep for the symbol, then exclude any hit containing an allow
# substring). A `#` note with no `allow` prefix documents a survivor that
# was found but NOT whitelisted — it still matches and is real follow-up
# debt, not something judged worth keeping.
#
# Checked 2026-07-02 against apps/desktop/ source (main/, renderer/, tests/).
# dist/ is excluded — it's generated by `yarn build` and was stale at check
# time; a fresh build regenerates it from the now-clean source.

peek://app/page
